newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Aker Maritime profits seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Aker Maritime profits seen up.

text.p: Offshore services group Aker Maritime ASA is expected to to post full-year 1996 profits before tax of 290 million crowns, a Reuter poll of nine analysts showed on Tuesday.

Aker Maritime was formed last year after Aker ASA spun off its Oil and Gas Technology division and announced a merger with offshore supplier Maritime Group. AKER ASA later announced it would join forces with investment group Resource Group International ASA (RGI) to form AKER RGI ASA.
Both companies are listed on the Oslo bourse.
According to proforma figures presented during the Aker ASA-RGI merger, Aker Maritime group had a pre-tax profit of 182 million crowns.
Three of the analysts recommended to buy the share, one said hold and four said sell. One declined to provide a recommendation.
"I think the company is good, but everything has its own price," said one of the analysts with a sell recommendation.
The company's share price has climbed a steep 38 percent from 87 crowns on January 17 to today's level of around 120 crowns.
